mechanism: Both drugs block the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) through different mechanisms, leading to synergistic potassium retention and increased serum potassium levels with risk of hyperkalemia.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely; use combination cautiously in patients with CKD, diabetes, or baseline renal impairment; consider dose adjustment or alternative therapy if potassium exceeds 5.5 mEq/L.
